items.title: New iOS Video Injection Tool Bypasses Biometric Verification with Jailbroken iPhones
items.description: A sophisticated new attack tool targeting jailbroken iOS devices has emerged, representing a significant escalation in digital identity fraud capabilities. items.title: CISA Warns of Two Malware Strains Exploiting Ivanti EPMM CVE-2025-4427 and CVE-2025-4428
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Thursday released details of two sets of malware that were discovered in an unnamed organization's network following the exploitation of security flaws in Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM). items.title: SolarWinds Releases Advisory on Salesloft Drift Security Incident
